newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express expands some routes.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express expands some routes.

text.p: Midwest Express Airlines Inc said Monday it will introduce twice-daily nonstop service between Kansas City and New York's La Guardia Airport, and enhance its service between Kansas City and Toronto, effective beginning May 1.

The nonstop La Guardia service includes early morning and mid-afternoon departures from Kansas City, and midday and evening departures from New York. In addition to the nonstop service, Midwest will continue to offer three direct flights between Kansas City and New York/La Guardia on weekdays.

The Toronto service offers early morning and mid-afternoon departures from Kansas City, and midday and evening flights on the return. While the airline currently offers connecting service to Toronto through Milwaukee, the enhanced service includes direct flights with schedules oriented toward business travelers.
Midwest offers four flights between Kansas City and Toronto each weekday. The carrier began serving Kansas City in November 1989.
Midwest is a subsidiary of Midwest Express Holdings Inc.
